text: {"lessons":["I added to several stocks in Period 4 and bought more Stock B in Period 5; next time I should check how each trade changes my overall allocation and keep enough cash for flexibility.","I made no trades from Period 6 through Period 10 while my account value rose and fell; I should avoid trading just to react to monthly fluctuations, but review whether my reasons for holding still make sense.","A short run of account-value changes cannot tell me whether I am on track to buy an apartment; I should use a clear long-term plan and assess progress over time rather than chase quick gains."]}
